summary: Quiet week: 30 messages (14 client, 16 team), down from 71. She is mid-house-move and says so ('This month has been the most hectic month! I will get on it! I promise!'). The biggest item is revenue she brought to us that nobody has answered. At 00:57 on Oct 1 she wrote that she has bought ten Halloween costumes for sexting sets, that Teddi 'said he will buy all of them' and that 'Usually he pays 1,000 per set!'. That is roughly $10,000 of pre-sold demand. Fred, who owns the OnlyFans side, posted ZERO messages all window, so nobody has acknowledged it. The $4,000 of sexting sets she offered on Sep 18 also has not arrived and nobody has asked about it. The Sep 23 disclosure (she has been deleting our chatters' mis-sent old content out of frumby's inbox, at least 3 times, and paying him back in free content) got 'We'll check' and then nine days of nothing. No chatter named (70 days), no purchase-history check, no count of the real damage. Mica carried the team side: she re-sent the Reels Drive with its purpose ('this is your drive' / 'to upload reel content'), said ALTR would make new accounts for her, confirmed 'we made a new one for you!' on Sep 29, and restarted the weekly reel-inspo drop (first since Sep 15). That answers much of the 'which Drive is which' confusion. But it exposed a new gap: she thinks ALTR wanted to run her warmed-up second IG account, and she cannot hand it over because she does not know its username or password. Nobody replied to that. Invoicing: Stephski sent the Sept 15-30 invoice on cadence on Oct 1. She skipped the day-before withdrawal reminder, KEPT the 'to avoid any pausing in work' line we flagged for removal, and again did not confirm the Sep 18 full payment (14 days) or the Sep 3 invoice (29 days). DMCA leak-removal updates are now 24 days absent in this chat, a third consecutive missed window. TikTok is 45 days untouched. She answered Melissa's agency-wide intake-form broadcast with enthusiasm ('Yessss I'll add a bunch of stuff to it!'). CHURN WATCH: no exit signals this week. No asks for exports or data, no mention of other agencies, no fast-pay-and-silence (no payment was due). Her tone is warm and she is proposing new revenue. The one pattern to keep watching: she keeps taking ALTR's work on herself ('I'll upload everything myself for u and put it all in a folder on OF to sell'), the same 'doing it myself' signal as the Sep 23 disclosure. Her message volume fell from 48 to 14, but the move explains it.

Nine days after we learned she has been silently cleaning up our old-content mistakes for frumby, she has had no follow-up. Melissa's intake form drew an immediate, enthusiastic yes. The client is upbeat, explains every delay and is planning content around her best spender. Churn: no explicit signals (no exports or logins requested, no other agency mentioned, no unusual payment behaviour). The standing concern is that she is routing around ALTR rather than leaving it: she pre-sells to Teddi herself, uploads and folders the content herself, and says so. Her volume drop (48 to 14 client messages) is explained by the move, not disengagement.
